scripts.dev:flutter: cd flutter/desktop && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && flutter run
scripts.build:flutter: cd flutter/desktop && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && flutter build release
scripts.build:web: cd flutter/desktop && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && flutter build web
scripts.build:all: npm run build:flutter && npm run build
scripts.codegen: cd flutter/desktop && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
scripts.codegen:watch: cd flutter/desktop && flutter pub run build_runner watch --delete-conflicting-outputs
scripts.install: cd src && bun install && cd ../flutter/desktop && flutter pub get
scripts.install:deps: bun install && cd flutter/desktop && flutter pub get && cd src-tauri && cargo fetch
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:flutter
scripts.typecheck: echo 'No TypeScript files to check in this project'
